Evolution Golf · Design system v0.1

One system for every screen

Colour tokens, type scale, spacing, and the components the homepage and every later page are built from. Mobile first; tap targets 44px minimum; contrast checked against WCAG 2.2 AA.

Colour

White backgrounds. Brand green is the primary colour; one accent (red) is reserved for sale prices and alerts. Neutrals are cool greys: no cream or beige anywhere.

Type

Headlines: Source Serif 4 (variable, optical sizing). Body and UI: Inter (variable). Both self-hosted, Open Font License. Sizes are fluid between 390px and 1440px.

Display · serif 600 · 36→60px · line-height 1.1Free fitting in Ringwood
H1 · serif 600 · 32→48pxThe 2026 Motocaddy range
H2 · serif 600 · 26→38pxShop clubs by brand
H3 · serif 600 · 20→24pxCustom or standard?
H4 · sans 600 · 18pxWorked example
Lead · sans 400 · 18px · ink-700Clubs that suit your swing, not an average one.
Body · sans 400 · 16px · line-height 1.6Every model comes with a choice of battery. We set each trolley up before it leaves us.
Small · 14pxFree next-day delivery over £500 when you order by 1pm.
Caption · 13px (smallest size allowed)Prices include VAT.
Eyebrow · sans 600 · 13px · tracked capsCustom fitting

Spacing

4px base. Sections use a fluid gap (48→96px). Side gutter: 16px on phones, 32px tablet, 48px desktop; content max 1280px.

Buttons

Primary, secondary and text. Minimum height 44px (52px for large). One primary action per view where possible.

Badges

Stock states are always words, never colour alone. "Available to order" is kept separate from "In stock" so the in-stock filter stays truthful (order-on-demand lines currently show as available at zero stock). The TBC marker flags any fact still awaiting an owner decision.

In stockIn stock · Ultra batteryAvailable to orderOut of stock 2026SaleMember priceGPSDownhill control Fact awaiting decisionTBC

Price & rating

Prices include VAT. The member price sits next to the standard price, never instead of it. Star ratings are product-level only (Judge.me per product); store-level Trustpilot scores never appear next to a product title.

Photography

Product shots: real Shopify images on white, without baked-in text (several current main images carry a FREE GIFT roundel, so the mockups use the clean gallery shots). Lifestyle: placeholders until the Ringwood centre, fitters and trolleys-on-course are shot. No AI-generated people.

Photo to comeRingwood centre exterior with signage
Photo to comeMotocaddy trolley on a local course, golfer from behind

Banners

Live HTML text over an image with a gradient scrim for contrast. Text is never baked into the image, so it stays readable, translatable and accessible.

Photo to comeWide lifestyle image: fitting bay or course

Banner component

Spring fitting days in Ringwood

Live text sits on a dark scrim so it passes contrast on any photo.

Book a slot

Notices

Informational (green) and alert (accent). Used sparingly: no stacked promo strips.

Order by 1pm for free next-day delivery on orders over £500.
Only 1 left in stock. Order soon or reserve for collection in Ringwood.

Form fields

Visible labels on every field, hints below labels, errors in text and colour, 44px minimum height. Marketing consent is unticked by default.

Rough is fine. Leave blank if you don’t have one.
Enter an email address like name@example.com

Modal

Bottom sheet on phones, centred dialog from 768px. Focus is trapped inside, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.

Choose your free accessory TBC

Pick one gift to go with your Motocaddy M5 GPS DHC. Gift options come from the free-gift app and are confirmed at checkout.

Cookie banner

UK GDPR / PECR: shown on first visit, Accept and Reject given equal weight, nothing non-essential runs until a choice is made. Fixed position, so it never shifts the layout.

Cookies on Evolution Golf

We use essential cookies to run the site. With your permission we’d also like to use analytics and marketing cookies to improve it. Cookie policy
